title: Why Plans Need Control Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 32
description:
Laddoo Lab now sells in ten local shops, a supermarket chain and an online shop. Then, during the festive offer, the supermarket shelf sat empty for a whole week, and nobody noticed. In this animated lesson, Zoya and her team sit around Nani's kitchen table to write their first real marketing plan, and learn how to check it every month.

You will see what a marketing plan is (a written map: where we are, where we want to go, how we will get there) and the four questions every plan answers. Then we watch marketing control run live, month by month: set the goal, measure, find the cause, fix it, on a goal-vs-real chart where February falls 600 packs short and the team finds out why. We meet Kotler and Keller's four kinds of control, with real workplace examples from a phone maker, a bakery, a food delivery app and a bank. And we look at the human side honestly: plans give clear jobs and early warnings, but they can turn into paperwork, as Dwight Eisenhower said in 1957: plans are worthless, but planning is everything.

This is Episode 32 of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
